{{Top|leg}}
'''The Imperial''' was a luxury [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in the upper levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where prices started at 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] for a basic room. It could provide almost any service to wealthy [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. However, [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] were unwelcome in it and privacy for the guests could only be obtained through bribery.
